text: This is MQKit: 44 tools for your files, in one free app for Windows.
say: This is M Q Kit: forty-four tools for your files, in one free app for Windows.

text: Everything happens on your own computer. Your files are never uploaded.
Type what you want to do, in your own words, or a tool's number.
Or just drop your files in, and MQKit shows the tools that fit them.
say: Or just drop your files in, and M Q Kit shows the tools that fit them.

text: To shrink a PDF, say what it's for, and see how big it will be before you start.
The result is a new file. Your originals stay untouched.
Photos from an iPhone? Turn them into JPGs, a whole folder at once.
Need the sound from a video? One click, and it's an MP3.
Light or dark, it follows Windows.
MQKit is free, with no ads and no account. Get it at mqkit.com.
